subject: Segregated remit matrix + VAT mapping for multi-entity invoice collection
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@trivera.health>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Trivera Finance <ar@trivera.health>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 16:23:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing for Q3 pilot — remit split question

Hi Rishi / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement flagged that Trivera will need a single consolidated invoice per month but the payment needs to be split across three legal entities and routed to different remittance accounts (US operating entity, UK subsidiary for VAT, and our EU entity for certain EEA customers). We attached an example invoice (pdf) and sketched the remittance accounts.

Two clarifying asks:
- Can Redwood issue a consolidated invoice with line-level entity tags so our AR system can auto-route payments?
- How does Redwood handle VAT registration differences and invoice-specific VAT numbers per billed line? We may need the invoice to show a VAT registration per line item (or at least per grouped line) for compliance.

We are on a tight timeline — preferred go-live for the pilot billing is 2025-07-20. Can you confirm whether this is feasible and what info you need from us (bank details, VAT numbers, PO mapping)?

Best,
Elena
Director of Finance, Trivera Health
[Attachment: trivera_invoice_example.pdf (PDF)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@trivera.health>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing for Q3 pilot — remit split question

Elena — thanks, this is helpful context. Short answers up front: yes, we can support consolidated monthly invoices with line-level entity tagging; and yes, we can emit VAT registration numbers at the line or grouped-line level depending on how you want the grouping.

What I recommend next (so we hit 2025-07-20):
1) We’ll provide a CSV template for a remit->entity->cost-center matrix. Please fill with the three entities, their VAT numbers, and target GL/cost-center codes. (Attaching v1.)
2) We’ll need an authoritative list of bank remittance instructions per entity (routing, account, SWIFT/IBAN) and the preferred payment terms per entity.
3) For VAT: tell us which lines require local VAT vs. reverse charge. If you’re able to flag by customer (EEA vs non-EEA) we can apply the right VAT display on the invoice lines.
4) Legal: if your AP needs a submitted PO format, attach an example.

Marcus — can your billing team confirm the downstream GL mapping and whether we should stamp each line with both entity and cost_center codes (preferred for automation) or use grouped subtotals per entity?

Kimberly — please confirm whether we should expose the entity VAT registration in the invoice header, on each line, or include a consolidated appendix with the per-line mapping for compliance/audit.

I’ll turn this into a short mutual action plan once we have the filled CSV. Happy to hop on a call tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

— Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: split_remit_matrix_v1.csv (CSV)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@trivera.health>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 15:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing for Q3 pilot — remit split question

Elena — looping in our billing ops and tax lead (kimberly@redwood.com). A few operational notes from our side:

- Automation: We prefer stamping each invoice line with an "entity_id" and "cost_center" column in our invoicing engine. That allows us to generate the consolidated invoice that includes invisible routing metadata for your AR system and a human-readable breakdown for your AP.
- Payments: For clearing, we can emit a single invoice total and provide a payment allocation schedule (PDF annex) that maps the total to the three remit accounts; alternatively we can produce a consolidated invoice with three separate remit stubs. We need to know which format your bank/treasury prefers.
- VAT handling: We can display VAT registration number per grouped lines. If you need per-line VAT numbers (for mixed-item shipments with different VAT jurisdictions) we'll need a per-line jurisdiction code in the CSV.
- Timing: To meet 07/20 go-live we need your completed CSV and bank remit details by 07/07. Any delays will push the pilot billing to the next monthly run.

Action items for Trivera (please):
- Fill split_remit_matrix_v1.csv with entity_id, entity_name, vat_number, remit_account, remit_instructions, currency, cost_center_code, jurisdiction_code (if applicable).
- Confirm preferred consolidated invoice format (single total + allocation annex OR multiple remit stubs).

If you’re ok, I’ll draft the invoice template and sample allocation annex for your AR to validate.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Manager, Billing Systems

On Tue, Jul 1, 2025 at 10:12 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Elena — thanks, this is helpful context. Short answers up front: yes, we can support consolidated monthly invoices with line-level entity tagging; and yes, we can emit VAT registration numbers at the line or grouped-line level depending on how you want the grouping.
> 
> — Rishi

From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@trivera.health>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Trivera Finance <ar@trivera.health>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 08:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Billing for Q3 pilot — remit split question

Thanks Rishi / Marcus — this all looks reasonable. We discussed internally and prefer:
- consolidated invoice with a single total + an allocation annex (PDF) that lists the line-level splits and remit instructions (our bank prefers a single payment advise per invoice).
- VAT: we will provide VAT registration numbers per entity and jurisdiction_code per line when relevant. If Redwood can include the VAT registration in the annex (and grouped header for entity), that will satisfy our auditors.
- Timeline: we’ll complete the CSV and provide bank details by 2025-07-06 (giving you one business day buffer before your 07/07 target).

I attached a filled sample for two lines to illustrate mapping and a draft PO. Will follow up with the full CSV later today.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — please proceed to draft the sample annex and format so we can validate.

Best,
Elena
Director of Finance, Trivera Health
[Attachment: trivera_invoice_mapping_sample.csv (CSV), PO-TRV-0087.pdf (PDF)]
